root_cause: Production-path classifier treated tools/delivery and tools/supabase deployment tooling as unknown production runtime, causing a Supabase-only closure to seek Netlify readback when code and governance files changed together.

evidence.exposed_risk: terminal control-plane tooling appears as other runtime in release classifier

intervention: Ignore only the recognized deployment-control-plane prefixes when calculating production runtime, preserving unknown application paths as fail closed.
prevention: Regression test replays complete modified-path set of PR #4142; require no unknown runtime or Netlify for an Edge-only release, while mixed paths retain both authorities.
